why: Only one major reviewer, Macworld, answers this exact question with testing. It covers it in three pages: an AceFast Z9 Pro review, a Mophie StealthCharge review, and a MagSafe guide whose 4-in-1 pick has a 60W MacBook cable and a 100W charger. No second major reviewer does: WIRED tests only 3-in-1 stations, and TechRadar covers only charger bricks. The rest are listicles, spam clones and a single Apple Store listing. A new page comparing several MacBook-capable stations could get in, but it would be up against Macworld.
